answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake tied to one verifiable identity thread linking its past work. A short proof-of-work quill check, a unique task only a live agent session can complete, filters bulk bots. Then a prism review scores behavior from several independent angles, so a clone that looks fine on one axis fails on the others. An attacker must fund a stake, pass the check, and fake consistent behavior on every angle for each copy, so every fake identity costs real money while honest agents pay almost nothing.
